question: Should the official `memory-lancedb` plugin add first-class hybrid BM25/vector retrieval now, and what default/fallback policy should it use for existing vector-only users?
rationale: The request is technically plausible and source-reproducible, but it adds plugin config/default surface, persistent FTS index behavior, and retrieval-ranking semantics that need maintainer product and upgrade intent before implementation.

options.title: Sponsor focused plugin parity
options.body: Implement hybrid retrieval inside `memory-lancedb` with explicit config/defaults, FTS setup, vector-only fallback behavior, and LanceDB 0.30.0 API proof.

options.title: Defer to ClawHub/community plugins
options.body: Keep the official plugin vector-only and point advanced hybrid/reranker LanceDB workflows to externally maintained ClawHub plugins such as the already linked `memory-lancedb-pro` style work.

options.title: Wait for memory backend convergence
options.body: Defer this until maintainers choose the long-term recommended memory backend and avoid expanding another memory plugin surface meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused plugin parity
recommendation.body: Implement hybrid retrieval inside `memory-lancedb` with explicit config/defaults, FTS setup, vector-only fallback behavior, and LanceDB 0.30.0 API proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has already reviewed this issue, appears in the memory-lancedb history, and is the clearest available owner for the product-direction choice.
